proposals.title: Pin proposals
proposals.explain: When a rep checks in at a clinic that has no location, their check-in position is proposed here. Approve it to make it the clinic's verified pin, or reject it with a reason.
proposals.supersededNote: Replaced: the clinic got its location another way.
proposals.inaccurateHint: This position is not accurate enough to become the clinic pin. Reject it, or set the pin on the customer page.
